card.statement:
Let $V\in \L$, $N$ be a submodule of $M_{\p}(V)$ and $N^T=N\cap M^T(V)$.
If $\Spec_V c$ does not contain $0$ then

- [(i)] $N\simeq U(\g)\otimes_{U(\P_T)}N^T$ where $\n_T$ acts trivially on
$N^T$, in particular, $N\simeq U(\sigma(\n_T))\otimes_{\C}N^T$ as a vector
space;

- [(ii)] If $V$ is a simple object in $\L$, then $L_{\p}(V)\simeq U(\g)
\otimes_{U(\P_T)}L^T(V)$, where $\n_T$ acts trivially on $L^T$, in particular,
$L_{\p}(V)\simeq U(\sigma(\n_T))\otimes_{\C}L^T(V)$ as a vector space.
card.label: Theorem 2

paper.title: Structure of parabolically induced modules for affine Kac-Moody algebras
paper.abstract: The main result of the paper establishes the irreducibility of a large family of nonzero central charge induced modules over Affine Lie algebras for any non standard parabolic subalgebra. It generalizes all previously known partial results and provides a a construction of many new irreducible modules.
